clauses.reason: EO 11299 amends section 2 of EO 11248 (level V) by adding item (9), Director, Urban Transportation Administration, Department of Housing and Urban Development. EO 11604 (July 2, 1971) renumbered the item without changing it. EO 11634 (December 6, 1971) amended section 2 of EO 11248 “By deleting”, with no replacement text, the item then numbered (8), Director, Urban Transportation Administration, Department of Housing and Urban Development (its item list also deletes a Post Office Department item and renumbers the rest); a deletion without replacement removes the placement, unlike a strike-and-insert amendment, so this is the first end of the clause (the held text has no effective-date provision; the signing date is used). The Reorganization Plan No. 2 of 1968 transfer of urban mass transportation functions is not held and is not relied on; no held source shows it extinguished the designation before this deletion.

inventory_overrides.reason: Inventory correction: the packet's machine segmentation did not match the order's operative units; this span is exact text of the held original and covers the lead or introduction together with the placement or permission it makes operative.

research_rationale:
EO 11299 (signed 1966-08-15; 31 FR 10917) was read in full in the held Federal Register text layer. Acting under subsection (f) of section 303 of the Government Employees Salary Reform Act of 1964, it amends section 2 of Executive Order No. 11248 of October 10, 1965, as amended, by adding item (9), Director, Urban Transportation Administration, Department of Housing and Urban Development, to level V. The packet's machine inventory also swept in the Civil Service Commission and other documents that follow the order on the same Federal Register pages (offsets 1776 to 7499, including an Excepted Service rule 'until December 31, 1967'); those are different documents, not clauses of this order, and I corrected the inventory by override to the order's single operative clause (lead plus item). EO 11604 (1971-07-02) renumbered the item (items (9) through (24) as (8) through (23)). EO 11634 (signed 1971-12-06) amended section 2 of EO 11248 by deleting item (8), Director, Urban Transportation Administration, Department of Housing and Urban Development, outright, without inserting a replacement; a deletion without replacement removes the placement, so the clause first ended on 1971-12-06 (signing date; no effective-date provision), which is also the whole-order end. The later transfer of urban mass transportation functions out of that Department (Reorganization Plan No. 2 of 1968) is not held and is not used as an end: the placement stood in EO 11248 as amended, and was re-listed in numbering by EO 11604, until EO 11634 removed it, and I found no held instrument that extinguished it earlier. Original not an authenticated transcription: the held text is the OCR text layer of the official Federal Register issue; quotations avoid its recognition errors.
